data.title: Intel Discount Event: Save Big Until June 3
data.meta_title: Intel Discount Event: Save Big Until June 3
data.content:
Eyes up, Pilots—it’s time to upgrade! From May 23 (10:00 CEST/01:00 PT) to June 3 (10:00 CEST/01:00 PT), the Intel cost for upgrading Orochi and Phantom Modules, Weapons, and Supply and Cycle Gear will be reduced. 

Orochi 

Modules 

  • Orochi (Torso Module) – Common
  • Orochi (Chassis Module) – Common
  • Orochi (Shoulder Module) – Common
  • Zeus (Weapon) – Uncommon
  • Blast Wave (Supply Gear) – Uncommon
  • Recon Mode (Cycle Gear) – Uncommon

Phantom

Modules 

  • Phantom (Torso Module) – Uncommon
  • Phantom (Chassis Module) – Uncommon
  • Phantom (Shoulder Module) – Uncommon
  • Lighter (Weapon) – Common
  • Energy Wall (Supply Gear) – Common
  • Minefield (Cycle Gear) – Common

Upgrades 

Common

  • Level 3: 5 Intel (Reduced from 20 Intel)
  • Level 5: 10 Intel (Reduced from 40 Intel)
  • Level 9: 30 Intel (Reduced from 110 Intel)
  • Level 13: 100 Intel (Reduced from 230 Intel)

Uncommon 

  • Level 3: 6 Intel (Reduced from 30 Intel)
  • Level 5: 12 Intel (Reduced from 60 Intel)
  • Level 9: 40 Intel (Reduced from 165 Intel)
  • Level 13: 150 Intel (Reduced from 345 Intel)
     

Head to your Warehouse and start upgrading your War Robots today!

Note: During the Intel Discount Event, deconstructing Modules will result in lower Intel returned.
